units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 80b:16">B. Kam. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>הלוקח ע׳ בארץ וכ׳</he> he who buys a township in Palestine, is bound by law to buy also the accesses to it on four sides.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17b:10">Snh. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ע׳ שאין בה עשרה וכ׳</he> in a town in which there are not the following ten things (institutions), a scholar is not permitted to live.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:6">Snh. I, 6</cite> <he>וכמה יהא בע׳ וכ׳</he> and how large must the population of a town be, to be fit as a seat for a Sanhedrin? <cite ref="Yoma 20b">Yoma 20ᵇ</cite> <he>הָעִ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="T00390"><he>רומי</he></cite>) the City of Rome; <cite ref="Pesachim 119a">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>בָּעִ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ברומי</he>) in Rome; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P01361"><he>עָרִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00557"><he>עֲיָירוֹת</he></cite>.
